
# person_id and session are what make a subject a subject rather than a
# recording (see WorkSpace.personFor/sessionFor). Both are written by every
# current export, but a CSV produced before they existed has neither, and a
# report should still render against one: person then falls back to the
# recording itself, which is exactly what personFor does when nobody has
# said otherwise, so the models below are unchanged for such a file.
if (!"person_id" %in% names(dat)) dat$person_id <- as.character(dat$dataset)
if (!"session" %in% names(dat)) dat$session <- ""
dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(person_id = as.character(person_id),
         person_id = factor(ifelse(is.na(person_id) | person_id == "",
                                   as.character(dataset), person_id)),
         session = as.character(session),
